Privacy Policy

This policy explains how this static PROCARE INSURANCE website handles enquiry information.

Your enquiry details

The quote and renewal forms process the details you enter in your browser to prepare a WhatsApp message. This website does not store submissions in a database, accept document uploads, or display a receipt confirmation. You can review and edit the prepared message before sending it in WhatsApp.

WhatsApp and other third-party services

Continuing to WhatsApp passes your entered details in a link to WhatsApp, which is operated by Meta. Its own privacy policy and terms apply. Share documents directly through WhatsApp only as needed for your enquiry. Google Maps links open Google’s service to search for the office address. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives normal browser request information such as your IP address. The family photograph is sourced from Unsplash and served as a local website asset; no image request is sent to Unsplash while visiting.

Hosting and tracking

The website is hosted using OpenAI Sites. The hosting provider may process technical request information to deliver and secure the website. We have not added analytics, advertising trackers, or website cookies. This website does not save form entries to browser storage.

Information you send

Details you choose to send to Procare through WhatsApp are used to discuss your enquiry and provide requested service assistance. Do not enter payment details, medical records, or sensitive document numbers in website forms. Any information required by an insurer should be shared using the appropriate channel.

Contact

For questions about information shared with Procare, call +91 9061 6666 07 or visit Vailathur Road, Tanalur Junction, Malappuram, Kerala – 676307.
